examples.ur: Yeh kaam mukammal karne ki aakhri tareekh hamare plan ke liye zaroori hai.

examples.en: We discussed the deadline in yesterday's meeting.
examples.ur: Hum ne kal ki meeting mein kaam mukammal karne ki aakhri tareekh par baat ki.

examples.en: I will share the deadline with you tomorrow.
examples.ur: Main kal tumhare saath kaam mukammal karne ki aakhri tareekh share karunga/karungi.

examples.en: I usually deliver when I have enough time.
examples.ur: Main aam tor par pohanchana / deliver karna karta/karti hoon jab mere paas waqt hota hai.

examples.en: Yesterday, I had to deliver before leaving.
examples.ur: Kal mujhe jaane se pehle pohanchana / deliver karna karna para.

examples.en: I will deliver this task tomorrow.
examples.ur: Main kal yeh kaam pohanchana / deliver karna karunga/karungi.
